submission.justification: Mixture-G2 with a 1.0 mm gas gap is recommended as it achieves the best time resolution of 1.1 ns among all viable options. This exceeds the required 1.5 ns performance by 27%, directly addressing the goal of achieving the best possible time resolution. The mixture's GWP100 of 120 complies with the environmental policy limit of 150. While Mixture-G3 has a lower GWP100 (15), it delivers inferior time resolution (1.4 ns at 1.0 mm gap). Mixture-G1 is eliminated due to its excessive GWP100 of 1400. The 1.0 mm gap is optimal as it provides superior performance compared to larger gaps while remaining within the 1-3 mm constraint.
